profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 2 years of experience developing embedded C/C++ applications, deploying continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and writing unit/regression tests on an Agile team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Designed, developed, and tested (unit/regression) embedded radar software applications in C/C++ for LINUX platforms.
-Reduced software build time by 84% by implementing a Jenkins pipeline utilizing parallelization across build machines.
-Developed scripts in Python, Groovy, Perl, and Bash to automate tasks and workflow processes.
-Worked on an Agile team with a focus on DevOps and continuous integration/continuous deployment.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Jenkins · Shell Scripting · Embedded Systems · Continous Integration

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.locationName: New London, Connecticut, United States · On-site
positions.description:
-Courses: Algorithms, Computer Organization, Introduction to Computer Science, Advanced Regression Techniques.
-Tutored 30+ students each semester on concepts including object-oriented programming, algorithm design and complexity analysis, computer architecture, and regression analysis.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Algorithm Analysis · Time Complexity · Regression Analysis · Computer Architecture

positions.title: Data Analytics Intern
positions.description:
-Analyzed Unum's individual disability insurance sales using statistical methods including multivariate regression and analysis of variance (ANOVA).
-Created accessible visualizations to communicate trends, outliers, and patterns in the data.
-Collected and interpreted survey data regarding flex/hybrid work at Unum, presenting our findings as a team to senior leaders.
positions.insights: Skills: R · Python · ANOVA · Data Analysis · Data Visualization

honors.title: Sophomore Computer Science Award
honors.description: Recipient of the Sophomore Computer Science Award at Connecticut College.
honors.issuer: Issued by Connecticut College Computer Science Department · May 2020

honors.title: Microeconomics Award
honors.description: Recipient of the Microeconomics Award at Connecticut College. First freshman to receive this award in the history of the college.
honors.issuer: Issued by Connecticut College Economics Department · May 2019

projects.title: Unity Game Development
projects.description:
-Developed a 2D game using the Unity Game Engine.
-Worked with two other students to program and design the game in C#.

projects.title: COVID-19 Time Series Statistical Modeling
projects.description:
-Modeled the COVID-19 outbreak in R using time series analysis. 
-Analyzed how confirmed cases of COVID-19 are highly dependent on rates of testing.
